message: 成長のしるし

name: Sally
message: 「Zzz, zzz, mmm...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't she heavy?」

name: Synn
message: 「Not really」

name: Paqy
message: 「Floating demons are naturally light by nature, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder why, considering how much she eats?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe she just has bad fuel economy?」

name: Synn
message: 「Or maybe flying takes way more energy than it looks?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, a shooting star」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing unusual about that at this point」
For a while now, shooting stars had been raining down generously across the entire sky.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, yeah, true. Still, it kinda sets the mood, doesn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Does it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Turning even a familiar sight romantic through the magic of words」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You just thought the word 'romantic' doesn't suit Nanaka at all, didn't you!」

name: Synn
message: 「...A little」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look. You're walking home at night alone with a girl. Don't you think it's fine to let the atmosphere get a little romantic?」

name: Sally
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「We're not alone, though」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn. Pointing that out at a time like this is pretty tactless, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You shut up too」

name: Synn
message: 「Walking home at night like this isn't particularly unusual for us either」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, walking back together like this might actually be the first time in a while」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so? Haven't we been together all the time lately?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah. That's not what I mean...

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I mean just the two of us alone」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, it's not just the two of us alone」

name: Sally
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh... You're still such a dense blockhead as ever, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. That doesn't sound like a compliment」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because I wasn't complimenting you」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, well... maybe I'm glad you haven't changed」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no way I'd change. I'm me, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, but you know, people can change pretty easily」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like I went overseas for training and just came back」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't even have the money to travel」

name: Synn
message: 「It's just a figure of speech」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I know that」

name: Synn
message: 「Did something happen that would make me change?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Before I knew it, you went and became the Student Council President and all」

name: Synn
message: 「It wasn't 'before you knew it.' I did get voted in through an election, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, like I said, that's not what I'm getting at」

name: Synn
message: 「I did stop working part-time jobs, huh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, that's a little different from what I'm trying to say, too」

name: Synn
message: 「Really?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, maybe it's related?」

name: Synn
message: 「Which one is it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You spent all your time working part-time jobs, so you never really had much luck with girls, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「More like I had nothing to do with a sparkling school life」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And now look at you--Student Council President, surrounded by nothing but girls」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that's just how the Student Council ended up, so I can't help it」
Wait, why am I making excuses like this.

name: Nanaka
message: 「They're all cute, so you end up getting self-conscious around them, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「They're definitely cute, sure, but...」

name: Paqy
message: 「'Not as cute as you, Nanaka'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Really?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is what Soba wants you to say!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up. Quit using that confusing voice!」

name: Synn
message: 「You want me to say that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What are you talking about too?! As if!」

name: Synn
message: 「I do think they're cute, and sometimes I think, man, girls sure are great, but」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Only sometimes?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course I do. I'm not that dense」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're way too honest!」

name: Synn
message: 「Can't help it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I guess that's one of your good points. Synn is still Synn after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Naturally」

name: Synn
message: 「You haven't changed a bit either, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You think so?」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all since ten years ago」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Okay, now you're pushing it」

name: Synn
message: 「I said you haven't changed」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, isn't this the part where your heart skips a beat over your childhood friend who's grown up into a total woman before you knew it!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What are you staring at」
Looking closely at her like this... she's gotten rounder and softer in all sorts of places...
And cuter...

name: Synn
message: 「...Now that you mention it, I guess your chest did get a tiny bit bigger」
Whoa. Accidental sexual harassment!

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What are you saying! You lecherous Student Council President!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's Lord Synn's true nature for ya」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And 'a tiny bit' at that!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry. Still, I have to look first!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if you say that with all your might... Well, it's true you wouldn't know without looking, but still」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Actually, you don't even need to take a fresh look! You're already used to seeing me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, maybe being too used to seeing me is the problem...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-Ahem. Anyway, what's been seen can't be unseen」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, building off that... do you prefer them even bigger or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What are you asking, what!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like around Ria-senpai's size, for example?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I've never looked at Senpai with those kinds of lewd eyes!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you DO look at her when it's not with lewd thoughts」

name: Synn
message: 「I said it's not all the time!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Can't be helped. Lord Synn's a guy, after all」

name: Paqy
message: 「But I won't forgive it! 'Cause Ria-chan's boobs belong to yours truly!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Rakin!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, that chest of hers is a lethal weapon... Even as a girl, I catch myself staring sometimes...」

name: Synn
message: 「They really bounce, huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah... wait, you're totally having dirty thoughts!」

name: Synn
message: 「I dug my own grave!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa there, Synn's so perverted I almost went too far」

name: Synn
message: 「It's my fault?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We'll be holding a formal interrogation regarding Synn's perversion at a later date, thank you very much」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't! Or rather, please don't」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe I should ask Ria-senpai for her opinion too」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't need to ask her」

name: Synn
message: 「Also, sorry about earlier...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「About what?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... well... you too, Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like I said, what?」

name: Synn
message: 「How should I put it, you've gotten cute」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-wh-what are you saying to your childhood friend!」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'm telling the truth, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, I know you're saying that sincerely, Synn, but」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, saying that kind of thing to me isn't gonna get you anywhere」

name: Synn
message: 「Then who am I supposed to say it to?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Save lines like that for someone you're trying to hit on!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Hit on... Wouldn't that make me sound like some pickup artist?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, I know, I know. I don't think you're like that, Synn」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway, Mr. Student Council President. Hurry on home and get plenty of rest after today!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, ah, yeah. Good work to you too, Nanaka. Good night」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good night, Synn」
Nanaka gave a small wave and disappeared into the shopping district.
